title: Whole Screen Printing and Empty Drying Preparation Bay
description: One static screen-printing preparation bay containing four complete qualified originals at unchanged unit scale. A whole open worktable at the left supports the entire raised-screen-frame and cantilever-platen press, rigidly turned ninety degrees so its empty platen points inward. The complete six-tray drying rack stands independently at the rear-right with its open tray fronts toward the shared central floor; a whole two-basin painting tool cart stands separately at the forward-right edge. These three separated stations form an open-sided working bay, not the earlier side-by-side enlarger desk and rack or the two loaded L-shaped printing/sewing tables with a bookcase. Every original mesh, oriented triangle, internal hierarchy and complete PBR dictionary is preserved. No trays, leaves, cart basins or press parts are extracted, resized or recoloured. Only one scene-only finite floor is new. One scene and zero new models, four whole instances. No artwork, paper, ink, wet print or working material flow is supplied. Static placement only: no printing, drying speed, screen tension, press/cart motion, ergonomic clearance, chemical handling, equipment compatibility, load, installation or safe-workplace claim. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
